messages.sourceEnglish: Compare a fixed US station’s weather observations with clear dates and missing readings.
messages.text: Pimanisa swivonelo swa maxelo swa xitichi lexi nga cenciki xa US na masiku lama nga erivaleni na tinhlayo leti kayivelaka.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a public US weather station
messages.text: Kambela xitichi xa maxelo xa le rivaleni xa US
Masungulo ya matiko ya misava → United States

messages.sourceEnglish: Choose United States, then load the fixed public station example. Observation and retrieval times stay separate; this does not supply farm weather or planting advice.
messages.text: Hlawula United States, kutani u layicha xikombiso xa xitichi xa le rivaleni lexi nga cenciki. Mikarhi yo vona na yo kuma yi tshama yi hambanile; leswi a swi nyiki maxelo ya purasi kumbe switsundzuxo swo byala.
